_description: Shared conformance vectors for the revocation_witness Noir circuit and the HarpocratesRegistry Soroban contract (#98, #357). Both the Noir tests (nargo test) and the Rust contract tests use these same fixtures to prevent drift. Merkle depth is protocol-bounded at MAX_REVOCATION_WITNESS_DEPTH = 16 (MAX_REVOCATION_LEAVES = 65536).

revocation_tree.description: Default 8-leaf binary Pedersen Merkle tree with 2 revoked credentials (111 and 222) and 6 empty slots (0), bounded up to MAX_REVOCATION_WITNESS_DEPTH = 16 (65536 leaves).

positive_cases.name: valid_non_revocation_witness
positive_cases.description: Credential 12345 is not in the revocation set {111, 222}. Matches Prover.toml.

positive_cases.name: max_depth_non_revocation_witness
positive_cases.description: Credential 12345 verified against a maximum-depth (depth = 16, 65536-leaf) revocation tree.

negative_cases.name: revoked_credential_in_slot_0
negative_cases.description: Credential 12345 is placed into leaf_0 of the revocation tree. Circuit must reject at leaf_0 inequality check.

negative_cases.name: revoked_credential_in_slot_5
negative_cases.description: Credential 777 is placed into leaf_5. Circuit must reject at leaf_5 inequality check.

negative_cases.name: revoked_credential_in_slot_7
negative_cases.description: Credential 333 is placed into leaf_7 (last slot). Circuit must reject at leaf_7 inequality check.

negative_cases.name: wrong_credential_secret
negative_cases.description: Prover supplies credential_secret=12346 while public credential_root belongs to 12345.

negative_cases.name: wrong_nullifier_secret
negative_cases.description: Prover supplies nullifier_secret=99999 while public nullifier was derived with 67890.

negative_cases.name: tampered_revocation_root
negative_cases.description: Private leaves hash to valid root, but public revocation_root is tampered.

negative_cases.name: zero_domain_separator
negative_cases.description: Public domain_separator is all-zero. Rejected by both circuit and contract.

negative_cases.name: replayed_nullifier
negative_cases.description: Same nullifier submitted twice to the contract.

negative_cases.name: wrong_domain_separator
negative_cases.description: Public domain_separator does not match contract's compute_revocation_domain().

negative_cases.name: unregistered_credential_root
negative_cases.description: credential_root in public inputs does not exist in contract storage.

negative_cases.name: oversized_revocation_depth
negative_cases.description: Revocation Merkle depth above MAX_REVOCATION_WITNESS_DEPTH = 16 is rejected across Python, TypeScript, and Rust.

negative_cases.name: oversized_revocation_leaf_count
negative_cases.description: Revocation leaf count above MAX_REVOCATION_LEAVES = 65536 is rejected across Python, TypeScript, and Rust.

negative_cases.name: undersized_revocation_depth
negative_cases.description: Revocation Merkle depth below 1 is rejected across Python, TypeScript, and Rust.

negative_cases.name: non_power_of_two_revocation_leaves
negative_cases.description: Revocation leaf count must be a power of two within 2..=65536.
